description: This is a shell script used to test whether a specific TCP host and port are available. It includes functions to parse command-line arguments, wait for the host/port to become available with optional timeout, and execute subsequent commands based on the test result.

methods.name: echoerr
methods.description: Outputs error messages to standard error unless in quiet mode.

methods.name: wait_for
methods.description: Waits for a specific host and port to become available, with optional timeout, and reports when available.

methods.name: wait_for_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps wait_for to support SIGINT handling and timeout using the 'timeout' command.
